title: Execute audited Select component polish
description: Implement Select audit findings after modularization, respecting native select limits and deciding whether custom dropdown work is needed.
objective: Make Select professionally controllable without pretending browser-native dropdowns can be fully styled.
expected_outputs: Placeholder, arrow, state, spacing, and containment controls
Decision note if custom dropdown is deferred
acceptance_criteria: Select styling does not overpromise option-list control.
Long labels and narrow widths remain contained.
verification: PHP lint, JS syntax, CSS check, WP-CLI harness, and line-budget guard pass.

budgets.research_budget: local browser/native select constraints when needed
budgets.validation_budget: mechanical checks plus Guilherme visual QA

risks: Native select can remain the visual weak point if expectations are not bounded.
